KELAS KENDERAAN

Kelas 1: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan tiga atau empat roda (tidak

termasuk teksi dan bas)

Kelas 2: Kenderaan yang mempunyai dua gandar dan lima atau enam roda (tidak

termasuk bas)

Kelas 3: Kenderaan yang mempunyai tiga gandar atau lebih (tidak termasuk bas)

Kelas 4: Teksi

Kelas 5: Bas

Bagi maksud mengira bilangan gandar dan roda sesebuah kenderaan, gandar dan roda

mana-mana treler yang ditarik oleh kenderaan itu hendaklah termasuk sebagai

sebahagian daripada gandar dan roda kenderaan itu.".

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS) (JURU-JALAN

DUTA-BUKIT RAJA EXPRESSWAY, NORTH SOUTH EXPRESSWAY CENTRAL LINK AND

KUALA LUMPUR-JOHORE BAHRU EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2014

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads (Private

Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (Juru-Jalan Duta-Bukit Raja Expressway, North South

Expressway Central Link and Kuala Lumpur-Johore Bahru Expressway)

(Amendment) (No. 2) Order 2014.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 25 January 2014.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (Juru-Jalan DutaBukit Raja Expressway, North South Expressway Central Link and Kuala Lumpur-Johore

Bahru Expressway) Order 2002 [P.U. (A) 171/2002], which is referred to as the

"principal Order" in this Order, is amended—

(a) in subparagraph 2(1)—

(i) in the English language text, by substituting for the words "Third A

Schedule" the words "Third Schedule A"; and

(ii) by substituting for the words "Third Schedule A" the words "Third

Schedule B"; and

(b) in subsubparagraph 2(2)(a)—

(i) in the English language text, by substituting for the words "Third A

Schedule" the words "Third Schedule A"; and

(ii) by substituting for the words "Third Schedule A" the words "Third

Schedule B".

Amendment of Third A Schedule

3. The Third A Schedule to the principal Order is amended, in the English

language text, by substituting for the words "THIRD A SCHEDULE" the words

"THIRD SCHEDULE A".

New Third Schedule B

4. The principal Order is amended by inserting after the Third Schedule A the

following schedule:

CLASS OF VEHICLES

Class 1: Vehicles having two axles and three or four wheels (excluding taxis and buses)

Class 2: Vehicles having two axles and five or six wheels (excluding buses)

Class 3: Vehicles having three axles or more (excluding buses)

Class 4: Taxis

Class 5: Buses

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be included as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".
